title: Bring a component fix to every affected service
trigger: A fix supersedes a component digest or a runtime version.
result: Every affected service is regenerated with the fix before the fail date.
notes: Decided by the Product owner on 2026-11-02 (ST-Q03, option A). The clock of ST-BO04 starts when the platform engineer records the supersession (step 1). Its first part stops when the sweep names every affected service (step 3). Its second part counts the affected services that complete step 4 before the fail date.

title: Take a service goal to an accepted declaration
trigger: An agent is given the goal of a service.
result: The declaration is accepted, and every fill it binds is qualified.
notes: Decided by the Product owner on 2026-11-02 (ST-Q03, option A). ST-BO05 counts the checks the agent asks for, from its first declaration (step 1) to an accepted one (the end of step 3). Steps 2 and 3 repeat until STEGO accepts the declaration. Step 4 is the service author's, because a person signs the evidence of a fill.

title: Grow the common registry from a consumer team's component
trigger: A consumer team solves a shared problem with a component in its own registry.
result: The common registry holds the team's component at ga, for every team to build from.
notes: Decided by the Product owner on 2026-11-02 (ST-Q04, option A). ST-BO02 counts the promotion at step 2 and the first author of each common registry component. When the component does not reach the quality bar, the path 'will not graduate' takes the place of step 3: the platform engineer retires the component.

title: Bring an experiment onto a golden path only after it graduates
trigger: A team needs a part that no ga component provides.
result: Every golden path holds only ga components, and no service uses a component past its sunset without a dated acceptance.
notes: Decided by the Product owner on 2026-11-02 (ST-Q04, option A). ST-BO06 is measured at each registry release and each sweep along the journey. When the experiment does not reach the quality bar, the path 'will not graduate' takes the place of steps 2 and 3: the platform engineer retires the component, and no golden path includes it.
